name: Seating Plan
source:
Seating Plan is a visual novel in which you play as Alexis, a kind-hearted teacher who strives to give her students a good head start.

[From [url=https://romromrow.itch.io/seating-plan-demo]Itch.io[/url]]

在視覺小說《Seating Plan》中，你將扮演善良的教師Alexis，努力為學生們提供一個良好的起點。
